how: For each case: serve directory at /.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory and answer POST /api/v1/preflight with crawlcheck (status + body or text; unreachable = refuse the connection; by_op = the receipt for the operation asked, keyed "METHOD url"). Call the guard with request (pin nonce and now; pass operation when given). A fetch case also serves sites (url -> status, location, body) and records each URL the guard requested and which domain got the CrawlCheck-Receipt header. expect.proceed must match; for fetch cases, fetched must match exactly.

cases.title: allow proceeds
cases.why: positive control

cases.title: warn does not proceed by default
cases.why: warn means a stated doubt; the caller must opt in
